newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France June 97 cargo FTKs up 5.5pct.
newsitem.headline: Air France June 97 cargo FTKs up 5.5pct.

text.p: Air France said it transported 443 million freight tonne-kilometres (FTKs) last month, an increase of 5.5 percent on June 1996.
The FTK measurement is derived by multiplying the weight of cargo carried by the distance flown.
Its overall cargo load factor in June 1997 was down 1.2 percentage points on the same month in 1996 to 69.1 percent, the airline said.
In April-June 1997, the first quarter of its current financial year -- which runs until March 31 1998 -- Air France transported 1.27 billion FTKs, up nine percent on April-June 1996.
Overall cargo load factor in the three months in question was up 2.6 percentage points on the same period the previous year to 69 percent, the airline added.
